traits.name: Echolocation
traits.text: A sabosan can use their hearing as a precise sense at the listed range.

traits.name: Drain Blood
traits.text: ⬻ Requirements The sabosan has a creature grabbed Effect The sabosan drains blood from the creature. The creature must succeed at a DC 23 Fortitude save or become drained 1. The sabosan gains a number of temporary Hit Points equal to the number of Hit Points lost by the creature.

traits.name: Fell Shriek
traits.text: ⬺ (auditory); The sabosan emits a deafening cry in a 30-foot cone. Non-sabosan creatures in this area must each succeed at a DC 23 Fortitude save or be deafened for 1 minute.

traits.name: Powerful Charge
traits.text: ⬺ The sabosan Strides up to double their Speed and then makes a claw Strike. If the sabosan moved at least 20 feet, they deal an additional 1d6 (1d6) damage on a hit.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +15 (finesse); Damage 2d10+4 (2d10+4) piercing plus 1 persistent bleed

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +15 (agile, finesse); Damage 2d8+4 (2d8+4) slashing plus Grab
